research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1188- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1190- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1187- ## Where the evidence contradicts the request's assumptions
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1188- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1190- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1188- 
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1190- 
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1190- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1187- ## Where the evidence contradicts the request's assumptions
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1188- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1190- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1187- ## Where the evidence contradicts the request's assumptions
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1188- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1190- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1188- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1190- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.

docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1187- ## Where the evidence contradicts the request's assumptions
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1188- 
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1190- 
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1188- 
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1190- 
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1188- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1190- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1187- ## Where the evidence contradicts the request's assumptions
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1188- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1190- 
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1188- 
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1189- The request asks to be challenged. Five of its premises did not hold as stated.
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1190- 
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].

docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md:1191: 1. **"The Lead selects `codex-sol` for unrelated tasks."** Posse itself can do this without the Lead, through first-candidate Review auto-start [O: code and reproduction R1]. Of the 88 `codex-sol` Tasks, 85 were not image work and 73 were Review Tasks [O]. Auto-start cannot have started the 15 non-review Tasks, 3 of which were image work, so at least 12 non-image starts were Lead choices [I]. How the 73 reviews divide between auto-start and Lead choice is not recorded [H: mostly auto-start].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1192- 2. **"SQLite has accumulated a significant amount of state."** It has, but the store is not the cause. The review and delivery model is, and a parallel TOML layer costs more than SQLite tuning [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1193- 3. **"Posse has become too system-oriented" as a general statement.** The dispatch path on a fresh home is two commands and a three-key file (E1.7, E1.8). The weight is in what happens after `done` for code changes, and in configuration.
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1194- 4. **"Firstmate's dispatch is flexible."** Its intake judgment is flexible. Its launch is more locked down than Posse's and recently became stricter (`18b20eaf`, 2026-11-08) [O].
docs/research/2026-11-12-posse-reassessment.md-1195- 5. **"Profile, Kind and Dispatch Rule may be unnecessary indirection."** Kind and Profile are distinct and useful. The indirection that fails is the rule layer, which is four mechanisms answering one question with no data about purpose [O, I].
